list.title: How to use Body Acne Pack?
list.content:
Step 1
Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin. Rinse and pat dry
Step 2
Post shower, apply the moisturiser all over the body

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: How long must I use this pack to see results?
list.content: You will notice visible reduction in body acne with 2-3 months of use. With ethe bdy acne marks : changes depend on the severity of the condition but most people see a change within 3 months of usage.

list.title: What are the side effects of this pack?
list.content: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

list.title: What else can I use with this pack?
list.content: In case you have active acne - post shower you can use a gel/spray over the acne before using the lotion.

list.title: Why should I use this bodywash?
list.content: Enriched with Salicylic Acid - this is a bodywash that does more- it cleanses your pores, prevent acne formation and also helps gently exfoliate skin.
